While the overall shape is correct, the specific geometry of the keys is nonsensical. Several keys appear to float or merge into the wood without clear rod connections or pivot points. The complexity of the bassoon keywork is simplified into vague metallic blobs rather than precise mechanical parts.
The vertical lines of the doorframe behind the subject waver slightly and do not remain perfectly straight, suggesting minor geometric instability in the background generation.
